versions.changelog:
Initial release: Integrates BestYou health intelligence with your AI agent via MCP.

- Synchronizes data from Apple Watch, Oura Ring, CGM, and HealthKit to create an adaptive daily action plan.
- Provides tools to query readiness, generate personalized workouts, analyze meals, and manage your daily plan.
- Powered by 19 specialized on-device AI agents coordinating fitness, nutrition, sleep, and recovery.
- Emphasizes privacy: Only processed insights are shared; raw health data remains on your device.
- Includes clear setup instructions and safety guidelines for protecting user data.
